trigger: The police sent me an invitation
description: What to do if you receive a police invitation or are asked to 'come to the station'.

steps.text: Stay calm. An invitation is not a conviction; you are presumed innocent (s.36(5)).
Do not ignore it, but do not go alone if you can avoid it.
Contact a lawyer before you go, and arrange to go with them if possible.
Tell a trusted person where you are going and when.
At the station, you may remain silent until your lawyer is present (s.35(2)).
Ask what the matter is about and whether you are a suspect or a witness.
Do not sign any statement without reading it and speaking to your lawyer.
